reason: Parent-declared approximation: FY2024 Medical Services + Medical Support and Compliance + Medical Facilities actual net outlays transported one-for-one to CY2024. BEA investment, CFC, sales, purchased-care, territorial and timing adjustments are not performed. This is not an observed NIPA consumption decomposition; medical TEF remains outside the three-account mass.
current_key: health_other: MEPS TOTVA24 + TOTTRI24 + TOTOFD24 + TOTSTL24, pooled medical transport and case's lineage/native/coverage changes

va_medical_services_only.definition: Medical Services only; same declared FY-to-CY bridge.

va_medical_four_accounts.definition: All four accounts including Community Care; scope sensitivity, potentially double counts purchased care already removed on veterans_other, not a recommended joint correction.

application: Divide the selected national mass by the current health_services national amount and apply to its existing keyed engine, selected completion and matching typed coverage exposures. The remaining federal/state/local consumption, civilian OPEB and state-price corrections are held fixed. VA medical is a separate part within item13, not an additional item.
presence_source: https://www.bea.gov/sites/default/files/papers/BEA-WP2020-8.pdf, section2.2 p3; https://bea.gov/sites/default/files/papers/BEA-WP2025-7.pdf, medical care in veterans hospitals excluded from PCE and in government consumption
community_care_classification: BEA County Personal Income Concepts and Methods, Part V pp58, paragraphs5.43-5.44, explicitly includes veterans community care in personal current transfer receipts. Pinned NIPA T3.12 line20 footnote4 includes private-facility reimbursements from2015. Community care is excluded centrally; the four-account arm is a requested scope sensitivity with potential overlap against the existing veterans_other removal, not a preferred correction.
